part.text:
The Notifications tab is open in Bluesky. The screen shows the "Notifications" header with the All and Mentions tabs, and the bell icon in the bottom bar is now selected.

The simulator has no tap command, so I built a small XCUITest runner under `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/opencode/taprunner/` and used `xcodebuild test` to tap the bell. The runner was needed because the first attempt, `bluesky://notifications`, raised an "Open in Bluesky?" prompt that I had to clear before the tap could land. Earlier, a `https://bsky.app/notifications` link had opened Safari on the logged-out web page instead of the app.
